marlin_bay_unified_school_board_seven_tr.name: Marlin Bay Unified school board (seven trustees)

scene.note: events declared visible to this actor are directly experienced

memories.content: The board has the later-start-times proposal on its agenda for two September meetings. Two trustees are up for re-election in November. The proposal has been tabled twice since spring.

The Marlin Bay Unified school board holds two meetings in September 2026. The later-start-times proposal is on the agenda for both meetings. The board may take a recorded vote on the proposal at either meeting.
